title: [Crash] System.ArgumentException: The directory name 'D:\github\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG\bin\x64\Release\Settings' does...
author: bruste77
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.ArgumentException`
**Message:** The directory name 'D:\github\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG\bin\x64\Release\Settings' does not exist. (Parameter 'path')

### Stack Trace
```
   at void System.IO.FileSystemWatcher.CheckPathValidity(string path)
   at new System.IO.FileSystemWatcher(string path, string filter)
   at new mRemoteNG.Config.Connections.Multiuser.FileConnectionsUpdateChecker(string connectionFilePath)
   at void mRemoteNG.App.Startup.Cr...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
**Fixed.** The `FileConnectionsUpdateChecker` was creating a `FileSystemWatcher` for the `Settings` directory without ensuring it exists first. Added `Directory.CreateDirectory()` before the watcher initialization.

This crash occurs when running from a build directory where the Settings subfolder hasn't been created yet (portable edition first launch from a new location).

Will be in the next nightly build.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed in commit **[CENSORED!] Links to external GitHub repositories are not allowed** — the `ArgumentException` crash on startup when the Settings directory didn't exist has been resolved. The directory is now created automatically before use.
